verdict.rationale: TWC's public register-tax page states some account and credential prerequisites before the user starts: register through UTR, receive a TWC tax account number, use one user ID and password across UTR and UTS, and file any reports that are due during registration. It does not list identity-proofing steps or the full sequence of credential creation, and the application host could not be inspected to check whether the flow adds steps. Missing for 10: an explicit published list of identity-proofing requirements, a complete step-by-step list of account and credential setup stated upfront, and hands-on confirmation that the live flow adds no undisclosed steps.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: You can use the same user ID and password to access UTR and UTS.
UTR will allow you to immediately file any reports or pay taxes that are due. But you must do it as part of the registration process.
If you are liable, you will immediately receive a TWC tax account number.
